items.title: 1.8 Reactions of Na and Mg with water, oxygen and chlorine

source_refs.note: Topic 1.8, printed page 15: the heading topic whose detail is in 1.8.1 to 1.8.3; the period 3 original is placed here.

blocks.text: Sodium, in group 1, and magnesium, in group 2, both react with water, oxygen and chlorine.
